authority: This file is the single machine-readable source of truth for project status and the active work queue. Prose roadmap documents are historical context and do not override it.
rules: Work locally. Do not push to git without explicit approval.
Tests require PYTHONPATH set to the repo root.
Every change must pass the full suite and scripts/launch_check.sh before commit.
Prefer machine-readable specs over conceptual notes.

tracks.name: Observability and Execution Tracing
tracks.note: run --trace and --trace-limit exist; no structured trace export or span model

superseded.reason: Written before Phase 2; four of its five items were already implemented. Audited 2026-08-27 and reduced to a pointer at this file.

audit.evidence: tests/test_malformed.py covers parse_module only; bundles, manifests and hello payloads were uncovered
alp/integrity.py implements rsa-demo sign/verify; 24-bit unpadded modulus, not a real signature scheme

audit.item: workflow report script comparing outputs over repeated runs

week.theme: Close the gaps the transport layer exposed, then start agent identity.

tasks.title: Reconcile roadmaps into one machine-readable status file
tasks.why: Two conflicting roadmaps meant a fresh session could get different marching orders from NEXT_ACTIONS.md and the handoff.

tasks.title: Specify wall-clock to logical-clock mapping for non-local transports
tasks.why: The logical clock keeps the reference transport deterministic but leaves a real network transport unspecified. This blocks any second transport implementation.

tasks.title: Extend adversarial corpus to bundles, manifests and hello payloads
tasks.why: Every untrusted entry point should have a rejection test. Only the module parser had one.

tasks.title: Document what each trust artifact does and does not prove
tasks.why: A 24-bit unpadded RSA demo listed as a trust artifact in an agent-facing manifest is a misread waiting to happen.

tasks.title: Draft agent identity spec: keypair, agent_id derivation, envelope attribution
tasks.why: Transport delivers payloads but cannot say who sent them. Identity is the next structural gap, not another feature.
acceptance: spec/agent-identity-v0.2.md defines agent_id derivation and attribution fields
envelope schema gains an optional signed attribution block
backward compatible: unattributed envelopes still validate

tasks.title: Structured execution trace export from the transport receipt path
tasks.why: Receipts record outcomes but not the path taken. Agent debugging needs machine-readable spans, not stdout traces.
acceptance: receipt optionally carries a trace reference
trace export is deterministic and diffable across runs
test asserts two identical sends produce byte-identical traces

deferred.title: Replace rsa-demo with a real signature scheme (Ed25519 or RSA-PSS)
deferred.why_deferred: Conflicts with the stated zero-dependency stance (agent-manifest.json external_packages is empty). Needs an explicit decision on whether OpenALP takes a crypto dependency or ships a vendored implementation.
